about: Season pass missions. loginXP: pass XP for opening the game on a real day. period: day, week or month (a day is a real calendar day, a week is 7 days, a month is 30 days). metric: advance (days played), decision (decisions answered), event (events answered), answered (any inbox item answered), dailyGoal (the Home daily goal done), weekReport (weeks closed). target: how many of the metric finish it. xp: pass XP paid once per period. Keep the sums small: the pass is built to take a dedicated player about 90 of the 182 days.
